task_info.original_instruction:
Search for papers related to "Blue" in the cs.SE category on arXiv.

Use the available tools to search for papers. Filter the results by the cs.SE category and ensure the search query "Blue" is used.

Save the search results to /app/search_results.txt with the following format:
- For each paper found, include: Paper ID, Title, Authors (first 3), and Categories

If no results are found, leave search_results.txt empty.
